reviews.x: These are the same gel packs that were used at the Chronic pain recovery center I went to.  They are flexible even when frozen and stay really nice and cold for over an hour when in use.  I will be ordering more.

A REVIEW FROM Mrs. L.---These are the best gel packs. My physician recommended them for when I get sciatic nerve pain. After several minutes of application, the pain gradually recedes. Sometimes these gel packs are the only thing that works AT ALL.  I love them. I keep several in the freezer. They have been lifesavers for pain. I have gifted friends with these gel packs for pulled muscles, back strain, etc. Every friend I gave some to gave a positive response.  They take some amount of time to f

I have used these gel pack for 4 years.  Just ordered a second set of 3.  They work perfectly.  They freeze very cold yet always remain flexible.  A quick massage of the gel and they readily become pliable making them comfortable to use (no hard edges or lumps).  Retain their cooling properties for very long periods of time. Very sturdy.  After 4 years, none of my packs have leaked or ruptured.

reviews.t: Great for Raynaud's sufferers - also a cheap heated bed for small animals
reviews.x: Great for heating arthritic hands.  One minute in the microwave on each side keeps it warm for a long time.  I use it for my Raynaud's feet and hands.  Also a great cheap alternative to those expensive electric heated beds for small pets.  Just make sure to put it under a thin town before tucking it under your cat.

I had knee replacement so these gel packs were just the right size.  Just make sure you lay them flat in the freezer so the stuff inside is well distributed.  The packs are flexible and bend as needed.

reviews.t: BEST ICE PACK ON THE MARKET.
reviews.x: I have had arthritis since I was 18 months old, and I had 3 surgeries to fix my Scoliosis - I am 25 now and I still love icepacks to reduce my pain and inflammation. Therefore I have purchased and gone through a decent amount of icepacks in my lifetime. These icepacks are by far my favorite icepacks on the market. It is really hard to find icepacks that get very cold when put in the freezer and still are able to be formed to a joint or knee when taken out of the freezer. I love these icepacks so

I was introduced to these in a Chiropracter's office and I lost the one I had.  I ordered this three-pack and they work well for cold and hot applications.  The package is fairly durable.  What more can you ask for in a hot/cold pack?

My husband had knee replacement and has to keep ice packs on it constantly. This are perfect for laying over the knee. The price was great.  We already had one that we got from his chiropractor and I was so pleased to find them!

reviews.t: They stay colder a LOT longer than the traditional ice pack from the freezer!
reviews.x: I used this product to aid in recovery from physical therapy from a broken leg.  I HIGHLY recommend it.  You can also use it as warm therapy.  I will definitely be buying more of them.
I love these for cold therapy use. I keep in refrigerator & they so  comfortable to apply  & very helpful relieving knee pain & back pain. Thanks.  Good product line.

reviews.t: Freezes fast, flexible, light, reduces pain!
reviews.x: I have RA which affects my hands, wrists, elbows, knees, hips and shoulders. Left arm aches from damage caused by a blood clot. I use ice packs on a regular basis to relieve pain. I had previously used ice packs that were heavy, flat, frozen solid as a rock and felt like using a brick. I had to hold it in position or wait for it to the out to place around curves. These gel packs have been the best ice packs I’ve found yet! They come out of the freezer solid but will quickly conform to your body.

reviews.t: Gel packs - such a helpful product
reviews.x: I suffer from sciatica back pain, these gel packs are so helpful to me.  I am supposed to do yoga regularly and I can definitely feel my back pain getting worse when I do not do it.  I put one or two of these packs on my back (wrapped in a hand towel) for 10-15 minutes at a time which numbs and relieves the pain. reviews.t: Large product, but doesn't last long
reviews.x: Liked that they were larger than the free ones you get, however 7 months later I have one that is already leaking fluid.  I have used the others for years, now when I really need them for my surgeries they are starting to fall apart.  Very disappointed

The older I get, the more my knees hurt. One of these gel packs on each knee and the swelling subsides. These packs are easy to form around my knees perfectly. Compared to other brands I've purchased in the past, these are the ones to buy!

reviews.t: These feel great whether used as cold or warm packs
reviews.x: These feel great whether used as cold or warm packs, but they wear out too quickly when heated for warmth.  I do wish there were sleeves to put them in, too.  I've made my own.
These are excellent for hot or cold.  The difference from buying them 5 years ago, these are not filled as full as my first ones.  Disappointed but still a good product.
update-i have had all 3 fail by tearing open expelling gel everywhere. I will put them in a ziplock bag in the future to assure no ruptures while in freezer
Great for my migraines with it’s large surface area and great price for a 3 pack. Wrap in a wrung out dish towel with cold water for best results.
One of the best gel packs that I have found on the market really really like this and believe me I have a lot of pain and I've tried them all
I buy these for my terrible migraine headache I also suffer from neck and back pain. Just been care with them because they tear Easily.

Don't delay gel stays pliable even frozen lots of clever uses

reviews.x: Was planning total knee replacement and was told ice would be an extremely important part of my recovery. My refrigerator doesn’t make ice and purchasing it would require the space to store it. I decided to buy these and it was a fabulous choice! The hospital provided a sleeve to put ice into and instead I put these gel packs in. But you could wrap them in a pillowcase or lightweight towel. They stay cold for a remarkable period of time, they don’t leak and make me or my bed wet, and then they r

reviews.t: After 15 years and lots of use, mine is still going strong!
reviews.x: A chiropractor recommended this brand  Now, I've had one for over 15 years - and it is still like new! It has seen a lot of use! Very happy to see they are still being made and just got the larger size. I keep them in the freezer, and they are still pliable even when frozen. Wrap one in a towel and shape it to fit any body surface area. If it is frozen, don't place it directly against skin, wrap it in a towel. Great for aches and pains! I even sit on one to cool down after doing yard work. Deser

I have been using these for years ... I have many health issues and included in them is I get overheated all the time ...even in winter ...summers are brutal ... I use these on my neck (I put them in a small pillowcase as not to touch the skin directly) all day and sometimes all night...  I have several in my freezer so that when one gets warm I can take out another if needed..... These are my cooling off life saver!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the gel packs for staying flexible even when frozen and for retaining cold for a long time.
Many customers report the packs effectively relieve pain and inflammation for conditions like knee, back, and sciatic pain.
Several reviewers note the packs work well for both cold and hot therapy applications.
A few reviewers mention durability concerns, with packs leaking or wearing out over time, especially when heated.
Some customers note the packs are a good size and value, with one mentioning they were recommended by a physician or chiropractor.
